# Security policy

Report a vulnerability privately. Do not open a public issue.

- **GitHub:** [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/vszlx4/sqwer/security/advisories/new) (signed in to
  GitHub), or **Security → Report a vulnerability** on the repository.
- **Email:** [info@mughram.com](mailto:info@mughram.com?subject=Security%20vulnerability%20report) with the subject
  "Security vulnerability report". No GitHub account needed.

Include the steps to reproduce and the affected page or endpoint. The full disclosure policy is on the site at
`/security`.
